Kuvitus: saaristomaisema poikkileikkauks: Illustration: an archipelago landscape in cross-section at dusk. On the left, on the mainland shore, a power-line pylon and a grey substation. A dark submarine cable leaves the substation, descends along the rocky shore to the seabed, runs under the water along the sandy bottom and rises on the right onto an island. On the island there is a second small substation and a red cottage with light shining from its window. Behind the cottage a birch and a spruce, on the horizon distant islands.
Kaavakuva mittakaavassa: sama 40 kilowat: Diagram to scale: the same power of 40 kilowatts is transmitted through a cable whose resistance is 0.50 ohms. Upper bar: at a voltage of 230 volts the current is 174 amperes, and the reddish-brown part of the bar, the power of 15 kilowatts that turns into heat in the cable, is 38 per cent of the whole bar. Lower bar: at a voltage of 20 kilovolts the current is 2.0 amperes, and only 2.0 watts turns into heat, 0.005 per cent, which is thinner than a line in the bar.
Kaavakuva: positiivinen hiukkanen homoge: Diagram: a positive particle in a uniform magnetic field pointing into the paper (green crosses). The path of the particle is a dashed circle, which it goes round anticlockwise. At four points of the path a blue velocity arrow is along the path and a red arrow of the magnetic force points to the centre of the circle, perpendicular to the velocity. The radius r is marked from the centre to the path.
Kuvaaja: magneettivuon tiheys B mikrotes: Graph: the magnetic flux density B in microteslas as a function of the distance r in centimetres. Six black points at the distances 2–12 cm, values from 132 microteslas to 31 microteslas. A dashed curve through the points falls steeply and then levels off. When the distance doubles from 2 centimetres to 4 centimetres, the field decreases only from 132 to 72, not to half.

Graph: the magnetic flux density B in microteslas as a function of the reciprocal of the distance 1 over r in the unit 1 per metre. Six black points between 8 and 50 per metre, values from 31 to 132 microteslas. A rising straight line is fitted to the points and extended as a dashed line to the vertical axis, which it crosses at about 11 microteslas, clearly above the origin. Two points are circled on the line, (5.0; 23) and (50; 132), from which the slope of about 2.42 microteslas times metre is read.
Käsitekartta. Ylhäällä solmu magneettike: Concept map. At the top the node magnetic field: magnetic flux density B and magnetic flux phi = B A. Three branches lead down from it. Forces in a field, moving charge: magnetic force F M = Q v B perpendicular, force on a current-carrying wire F M = I l B perpendicular and field of a straight wire B = mu zero I over 2 pi r. Induction, changing flux: law of induction e = minus N delta phi over delta t, peak voltage of a generator u 0 = N A B times 2 pi f and transformer N 1 over N 2 = U 1 over U 2. Light, electromagnetic wave: law of refraction sine alpha 1 over sine alpha 2 = n 2 over n 1, grating equation d sine alpha = n lambda and Malus's law I = I 0 times cosine squared theta.
